articles.title: How to make a sales order
articles.summary: Confirm a customer order with a sales order in Nivesh Sahayak: their PO number, delivery date, items, status, then a challan or invoice from it.

articles.title: How sales order numbers work
articles.summary: How sales order numbers work in Nivesh Sahayak: SO series per business, restart every 1 April, change the prefix, and fix a duplicate number.

articles.title: Print, PDF and share a sales order
articles.summary: Print a sales order on A4, A5 or a thermal roll, pick one of 7 designs and copies, save a PDF, or share it on WhatsApp from Nivesh Sahayak.

articles.title: Saved sales orders: find, open, copy and edit
articles.card: Saved sales orders: open, copy, edit
articles.summary: Find any saved sales order in Nivesh Sahayak: search the Saved sales orders list, open to edit or reprint, copy it as new, set its status.
